ownerDecision.request: make a new polish version based on this style
ownerDecision.scope: One original Polish game concept, the PT-84 Orzeł, on the T-84BM Oplot-M / Oplot-T base of release 262 (profiles/oplotBM.ts, variant 'pl'). Poland never fielded the Oplot; the Orzeł is a what-if of the 2017 Bumar-Łabędy / KMDB PT-17 partnership on the Oplot itself, in the fleet's Polish Krata language.

pt84_orzel.silhouette: Polish game concept on the T-84BM Oplot-M's hull, six-wheel running gear and welded turret with its armoured bustle: framed ERAWA-2 Krata grids (cassettes 3 cm down in 9 cm welded frames) on the glacis (two 3 x 3 fields), the welded cheek boxes (five columns of two a side), the turret flanks (4 x 2) and every skirt panel; Tellur 81 mm banks, a round PCO panoramic commander's head, four Obra-3 heads, two ZSMU-1276 stations (a 12.7 mm WKM-B on a tower, a 7.62 mm UKM-2000), the rear stowage box and field basket, olive drums; the PT-17's 120 mm KBM2
